{{small|([[Chairperson]])}}|K. Paul Thomas
{{small|([[Managing director|MD]] & [[Chief executive officer|CEO]])}}}} | industry = [[Banking]] | num_employees = 4,100 | num_employees_year = 2022 | num_locations = 788 branches | revenue = {{up}} {{INRconvert|3141|c}} (FY23) | operating_income = {{up}} {{INRconvert|893|c}} (FY23) | net_income = {{up}} {{INRconvert|302|c}} (FY23){{cite news |title=ESAF Bank net profit soars 452% in FY23 |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/esaf-bank-net-profit-soars-452-in-fy23/article66837777.ece |access-date=31 October 2023 |work=BusinessLine |date=11 May 2023 |language=en}} | website = {{url|https://www.esaf.bank.in}} | founded = {{Start date and age|2017|03|10|df=yes}} | hq_location = [[Mannuthy]], [[Thrissur]] (Registered & Corporate Office) }} '''ESAF Small Finance Bank''' (formerly known as '''ESAF Microfinance and Investments''') is an Indian [[small finance bank]] headquartered in [[Thrissur city ]], [[Kerala]], providing banking services and small loans to the [[underbanked]]. Having started its operations as an [[NGO]] in 1992 under the name of ''Evangelical Social Action Forum'', ESAF Microfinance was a non-banking finance company and [[microfinance]] institution (NBFC-MFI), licensed by the [[Reserve Bank of India]] (RBI). It became a small finance bank in March 2017 and started operating in January 2018.{{Cite web |last=sundarajan |first=Priya |date=2017-03-17 |title=ESAF Small Finance Bank launched |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/esaf-small-finance-bank-kicks-off-operations/article9589191.ece |access-date=2024-03-31 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}} ==History and operations== On 11 March 1992, K. Paul Thomas,{{cite web|title=ESAF to graduate into a bank soon|url=https://english.manoramaonline.com/business/companies/esaf-to-graduate-into-a-bank-soon.html|website=OnManorama|access-date=18 March 2018|date=18 September 2015}} along with Mereena Paul and a few friends, started ESAF in a small house in [[Mannuthy]] named ''Little''.{{cite web|title=ESAF SFB fulfils banking dreams of common man|url=http://passlinebusinessmagazine.in/component/content/article/25-slider/675-esaf-sfb-fulfils-banking-dreams-pf-commom-man|website=passlinebusinessmagazine.in|access-date=18 March 2018|language=en-gb|date=4 August 2017|archive-date=16 June 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180616235044/http://passlinebusinessmagazine.in/component/content/article/25-slider/675-esaf-sfb-fulfils-banking-dreams-pf-commom-man|url-status=dead}} Jacob Samuel, one of the co-founders, coined the name ESAF, which is an acronym for Evangelical Social Action Forum. At inception, ESAF had five life members, seven annual members and eight honorary members. ESAF society was registered under the Travancore Cochin Literary, Scientific and Charitable Societies Registration Act. The initial president was Itty Mathew; J. Danabai was the vice president, Thomas was the secretary, supported by Samuel as joint secretary and Arun Ramakrishnan as treasurer.{{cite web|title=History at a glance|url=http://esafindia.org/home/history-at-a-glance-.html|website=ESAF India|access-date=20 March 2018|language=en-gb}} ESAF started providing interest free loans in 1995 as one of the first microfinance institutions in the country and the first microfinance company in Kerala. It became ESAF Small Finance Bank after receiving the first banking license in [[Kerala]] since independence.{{cite web|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/finance/rbi-issues-small-finance-bank-license-to-esaf-116111801066_1.html |title=RBI issues Small Finance Bank license to ESAFurl |newspaper=Business Standard |date=18 November 2016 |access-date=17 December 2016}}{{cite web|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/esaf-ties-up-with-fis-for-micro-finance-bank/articleshow/55605665.cms |title=ESAF ties up with FIS for micro finance bank |newspaper=Economic Times |date=24 November 2016 |access-date=17 December 2016}}{{cite web|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/finance/the-small-finance-bank-will-be-profitable-within-first-year-of-operations-k-paul-thomas-116061600298_1.html |title=The small finance bank will be profitable within first year of operations: K Paul Thomas |newspaper=Business Standard |date=16 June 2016 |access-date=17 December 2016}} On 17 March 2017, [[Pinarayi Vijayan]], the [[Chief Minister of Kerala]] officially inaugurated ESAF Small Finance Bank at [[Thrissur]], [[Kerala]]. By August 2017, the bank had 3,750 employees, 284 branches, and a presence in 11 states. In March 2018, a year after its launch, the bank had expanded to 4,000 employees and 400 branches, with {{currency|2,200|INR}} crore (US${{To USD|22000|IND|round=yes}} million) in deposits and {{currency|4,200|INR}} crore (US${{To USD|42000|IND|round=yes}} million) in loans.{{cite web|title=ESAF Crosses Rs.2300 Crore Retail Deposit in the first year - India Education Diary|url=http://indiaeducationdiary.in/esaf-crosses-rs-2300-crore-retail-deposit-first-year/|website=India Education Diary|access-date=20 March 2018|date=12 March 2018}}{{cite news|title=ESAF Bank to celebrate first anniversary|url=http://www.thehindu.com/todays-paper/tp-national/tp-kerala/esaf-bank-to-celebrate-first-anniversary/article23038308.ece|access-date=20 March 2018|work=The Hindu|date=11 March 2018|language=en-IN}} ESAF Small Finance Bank received RBI approval to operate as [[scheduled bank]] in December 2018, making it the fifth scheduled bank from Kerala. This will reduce the bank's cost of funds, while increasing the bank's ability and obligation to provide services.{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/with-rbi-nod-esaf-is-now-scheduled-bank/article25853930.ece|title=With RBI nod, ESAF is now scheduled bank|access-date=9 January 2019 |work=The Hindu BusinessLine |date=28 December 2018 |language=en}} The bank's net profit increased to {{currency|190.39|INR}} crore in the 2019-2020 financial year from {{currency|90.28|INR}} crore the previous year.{{cite news |title=ESAF Small Finance Bank Q4 profit up over 3-fold |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/esaf-small-finance-bank-q4-profit-up-over-3-fold/articleshow/69311821.cms |access-date=16 November 2019 |work=The Economic Times |date=13 May 2019}}{{Cite web|title=ESAF|url=https://www.esafbank.com/esaf-investor-info/|access-date=2020-11-03|website=www.esafbank.com}} On 26 March 2020, the bank received approval from [[Securities and Exchange Board of India|SEBI]] for issuing its {{currency|976|INR}} crore [[initial public offering]].{{Cite web|title=ESAF Small Finance Bank gets Sebi nod for IPO|url=https://in.finance.yahoo.com/news/esaf-small-finance-bank-gets-133824412.html|access-date=2021-03-24|website=in.finance.yahoo.com|language=en-IN}} ==Gallery== File:Pinarayi Vijayan inaugurating ESAF Small Finance Bank at Thrissur.jpg|Pinarayi Vijayan inaugurating ESAF Small Finance Bank at Thrissur in March, 2017 File:K.
